title: Dixieland, quadrilles, and brass and string band instrumentation
summary: He says Dixieland was always played, by the same bands that played quadrilles, and describes brass bands and string bands with no drums at dances.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: When did the guys start playing ragtime by ear? I wanted to ask you about that.
You mean that music?
Yeah, that Dixieland jazz, whatever you want to call it. When did it still?
Dixieland had been playing it always did.
They played it when you were a young man?
Oh yeah, they always did. That always was. Dixieland always was. Of course you know that always was Dixieland.
I thought they had all that quadrille stuff and all that.
Well that quadrille, all that and the Dixieland, all that. Well you see now, all them guys don't play that now.
When they had those quadrilles and mazookas and lances and varieties, they were playing Dixieland too? That's the time. And they played, they played both huh?

Same band? Same band, play all that. They'd play that? Well there was a brass band, they used to have brass band played and they used to have string band played too. He knows, they used to have string band played. You see, but they didn't have no drums, did they?
They didn't have drums in the old days?
Not when they played on the stands, but dances. They cut the drum out.
What would they have in the band?
Well the instrument I told you there, some drum and bass and that, have all the instruments except
the drums, they wouldn't have no trap drums. Oh just like the brass band, not have any drums huh?

No, not all on the playing, for dances. And the string band, he didn't have any of the cell. Just have bass, violin, and clarinet. They didn't, once once they didn't have saxophone, wasn't it? Once they didn't have saxophone.
What else would they have? They'd have clarinet, bass violin? Yeah, bass violin. A regular violin huh?
Yeah, violin and guitar.
Would they have any trumpets or?
Oh yeah, they have trumpets, sure they have trumpets. Trumpets, bass, violin, I told the guitar. And clarinet and the chamber on that's all.
